enrichment method: In parallel, RNA pull-down mass spectrometry assays were performed to identify proteins that form a complex with AC016745.3
instrument: An Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher) was used to perform mass-spectrometric sequencing with RNA pull-down protein.
labeling: The mass spectrometry proteomics data have been deposited to the ProteomeXchange Consortium via the PRIDE partner repository, with the dataset identifier PXD029141.
